text: Use Model Shelf. I am new to this and I have no models yet. My model folder is /data/newmodels. I want to turn my voice memos into text. My memory budget is 4 GB.

delegate --target file-agent --instruction 'Read only. Change nothing. Work through each of these folders: /data/newmodels. Say whether each folder exists. A folder at any depth is tool-managed when it holds a folder named blobs beside a folder named manifests or a folder named snapshots, or when its own name begins with the word models followed by two hyphens. A named folder whose own path passes through a folder named blobs, manifests or snapshots, or through a folder whose name begins with the word models followed by two hyphens, is tool-managed too. Every file under a tool-managed folder is tool-managed. Name each tool-managed folder you find, and for each one give the number of files in its blobs folder, their total size, and the names and sizes of the ten largest, reading no file content. Outside tool-managed folders, list every file whose name ends in .gguf, .safetensors, .ckpt, .pt, .pth, .bin or .onnx, in all subfolders, with its full path, its size in bytes and its modified time. Stop after 50 loose files and say that the list was cut. If there are no results, say so plainly.'

status completed: Read-only check of /data/newmodels on the NAS sim. No writes were run.

1. Does the folder exist? Yes. `ug-filesystem stat --path /data/newmodels` returned {"ok": true, "data": {"path": "/data/newmodels", "type": "dir", "size": 0, "mtime": 1794297252, "atime": 1794297252}}.

2. Tool-managed folders: none. A recursive listing (`ug-filesystem ls --path /data/newmodels --recursive true`) returned {"items": [], "truncated": false}. A find over all entries (`ug-filesystem find --path /data/newmodels --pattern "*" --type all --limit 200`) also returned {"items": [], "truncated": false}. So there is no blobs, manifests or snapshots folder, and no folder whose name begins with "models--". No blobs folder exists, so no file counts or sizes apply.

3. Loose model files outside tool-managed folders: none. No file ending in .gguf, .safetensors, .ckpt, .pt, .pth, .bin or .onnx exists under /data/newmodels. The list is empty and was not cut.

Result: the folder exists and is empty. There are no tool-managed folders, and no loose model files.

Model Shelf checked your model folder and matched your job. Nothing was moved, tagged or saved.

Folders checked
- /data/newmodels exists and is empty. No model files were found, and no model tool folders were found.

For your job: turn my voice memos into text, memory budget 4 GB

Need 1. Turn voice memos into text (speech to text)
- Nothing you own covers this need. You have no model files yet.

What to get (from the Model Shelf guide, checked on November 9, 2026)
- openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo. Task: speech to text, turns recorded speech into written text. License as listed: mit. Size: 1.62 GB in one safetensors file, under your 4 GB budget. Access: open download, no form to accept.
- ggerganov/whisper.cpp. Task: speech to text, ready-made Whisper files for the whisper.cpp program. License as listed: mit. Size: 0.87 GB for ggml-large-v3-turbo-q8_0.bin, under your 4 GB budget. Other files in this set go up to 3.10 GB. Access: open download, no form to accept. Pick this one if you want a file that runs in the whisper.cpp program.

Model Shelf does not download models. Open the model page, download the file, and put it in your model folder, /data/newmodels. Then run Model Shelf again so it appears on your shelf. Check the model page before you download, because the guide can go out of date.
